title: Italian-Style Flatbread
description: A crispy and flavorful flatbread inspired by Italian cuisine, perfect for snacking or as a side dish.
instructions: Slice the polish rye bread into 1-inch thick slices.
Brush the flatbread slices with olive oil and sprinkle with minced garlic, chopped rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Place the flatbread slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the flatbread is crispy and golden brown.
Meanwhile, toast the polish rye bread slices until lightly browned.
To assemble, place a toasted polish rye bread slice on top of each flatbread slice.
Drizzle with additional olive oil if desired.
